That's better than presidency's 3.25M bonus. But promissory in round 6 doesn't get redeemed... sell_credit vs sell — use sell. Shuttle gives 3 goods now; round 6 market sell for ~8+7+6=21 minus nothing, direct cash. That beats bribe.

Choose shuttle (choice 3).
